sentiment.summary: Usable Solana ecosystem coverage is too thin to assess sentiment. Of four collected records, only one CoinDesk item is clearly on-entity (a routing glitch that took nearly 29% of staked tokens offline; Foundation executives said blocks and transactions never stopped). The Cointelegraph and remaining CoinDesk items are off-topic, and the Reddit thread only names Solana among several chains at very low relevance from a partial source. Grounding and YouTube returned no results. The bar of three relevant records from at least two independent named sources with status ok is not met.
sentiment.coverage_note: Cointelegraph, CoinDesk, and Ethereum Foundation RSS are ok; grounding and YouTube are no-results; Reddit is partial. Four records were returned; only the CoinDesk Solana network-stress article is clearly relevant, so tags are empty.
